currentParagraphText: “I would say he should,” Miranda sighed. “He has been working with Jacob all along. To clarify, he isn’t part of the Holy Church, and the Great Bright One isn’t part of the Holy Pantheon either, but they are close allies of the Church. I’m still trying to figure out how exactly we’re going to deal with Kindroth. Still, it’s unquestionable he’s helped us out during this entire system event. He was also the one who tipped me off about Iludar’s ambush and helped set it up to eliminate this hidden threat.”
